title: Live Stream Performance and Audience Interaction
originalTitle: 【LIVE SHOW】Last of the Year! Singin' What I Feel Like! #HoloMyth #HololiveEnglish
lead: The speaker begins the live stream with an enthusiastic greeting, acknowledging the audience and expressing excitement about the performance. They mention the song 'Brand New Start' and emphasize a sense of renewal and determination.
summaryOneLine: The speaker begins the live stream with an enthusiastic greeting, acknowledging the audience and expressing excitement about the performance. They mention the song 'Brand New Start' and emphasize a sense of renewal and determination.
keyPoints: Audience Interaction and Transition to Rap
articleBodyHtml:
Introduction and Performance

The speaker begins the live stream with an enthusiastic greeting, acknowledging the audience and expressing excitement about the performance. They mention the song 'Brand New Start' and emphasize a sense of renewal and determination.

The speaker highlights the significance of the final song, acknowledging its high demand and the challenge of performing it, especially in comparison to the original version. They express a willingness to give their best despite the difficulty.

The speaker discusses the unique playback method of the final song, noting that it is played from YouTube rather than iTunes, and acknowledges the potential for a lag. They also reference the song's origin and content, including a mention of Dr. Seuss as the original writer of the lyrics.

Interactive Performance and Trick Segments

The speaker engages in a series of playful and interactive tricks involving bricks, blocks, chicks, clocks, and other objects. They interact with Mr. Knox and Mr. Fox, demonstrating quick wit and linguistic dexterity.

The speaker continues the trick segment with additional elements such as socks, crow, and knocks, repeating and expanding on earlier phrases involving bricks, blocks, and clocks. The dialogue becomes increasingly complex and playful.

Audience Interaction and Transition to Rap

The speaker thanks the audience, mentions links and Super Chats, and transitions into a rap segment. They express frustration about the heat in the room and the difficulty of performing the outro.

The speaker officially starts the rap segment and asks the audience to subscribe, continuing the interactive and engaging nature of the performance.
